goal: Independently replay existing frozen baseline Bybit ledger cash/fill/mark-to-market accounting and compare PNL, close-DD, LOW bound, underwater days and equity SHA with the already recorded summary; not a new backtest or trading candidate.
limits: Replay only prior ledger fills; use known bar closes/lows solely for mark-to-market after recorded fills. Do not infer stop fills from LOW. No fitting, new thresholds, rerunning research sweeps, new strategy, or claims of genuinely unseen evaluation.
accept: All 18 baseline ledger windows/profiles/capital cases independently reconcile cash, fees, fill prices, reference prices, position PnL, close-curve digest, close DD, low DD bound, underwater duration and published metrics; fail closed on discrepancy. If failing, do not authorize integrated economic simulation.
after_pass: Record a separate preregistered, limited integrated ablation with unchanged baseline and a strictly bounded candidate. The preexisting trigger +2%, stop 4% and entry-quality vetoes remain NO_PROMOTE. No automatic trading or merging.
